See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Dacryoserum/nyquist/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for changes.

**These builds are not code-signed or notarized.**

- **macOS** — the DMG contains a universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel. Gatekeeper may
  block the first launch: use the macOS Privacy & Security settings to explicitly allow the
  app only if you trust this download.
- **Windows** — the x64 installer may trigger SmartScreen. Use **More info → Run anyway**
  only if you trust this download.

All analysis runs locally; audio files are not uploaded.
